proof:
have hmem (x : ℝ) : x ∈ S ↔ x = 8 ∨ x = -14 := by
    rw [h₀]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hfact : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by nlinarith [h]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfact with hleft | hright
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  have hS : S = {8, -14} := by
    ext x
    simp [hmem]
  rw [hS]
  norm_num
